p1_readonly_posture_mvp.summary: An operator signs in, registers a read-only local fixture source, starts a scan, sees inventory and coverage, inspects masked classifications and findings, and follows declared AI application HR Bot to the payroll data it is configured to use. A rescan updates findings without duplication. Failed and unsupported files are visible.

p2_protected_rag_mvp.summary: Demo AI application HR Bot uses a separate PostgreSQL source with pgvector. Alice can retrieve a synthetic payroll document. Bob cannot. Access is checked before forbidden chunk content is returned to the application or sent to the model. The UI explains the decision using source versions and authorization evidence. Revocation and dependency-failure tests pass.

nine_questions.question: What sensitive data can an AI agent access
nine_questions.unknown_before: Without agent identity, tool bindings, source permissions, classification and a time-stamped access path, the product reports unknown rather than allowed.

nine_questions.question: Which RAG or vector databases contain regulated data
nine_questions.unknown_before: An embedding alone is not evidence of sensitive text or original permissions. Missing payload or provenance is unknown.

nine_questions.question: Which employees send sensitive information to AI services
nine_questions.unknown_before: A domain visit is not evidence of prompt content. Unmanaged traffic is outside coverage.

nine_questions.question: Which agents have excessive permissions
nine_questions.unknown_before: Unused access is a review signal, not proof that a permission is unnecessary.

nine_questions.question: What sensitive data enters an LLM prompt
nine_questions.unknown_before: The product cannot inspect a prompt it never sees. Unsupported attachments and bypass routes are blocked or clearly excluded.

nine_questions.question: What sensitive data an LLM returns
nine_questions.unknown_before: Bytes already sent cannot be retracted. Probabilistic detection is not a zero-leak guarantee.

nine_questions.question: Which MCP server or tool can access confidential data
nine_questions.unknown_before: Tool descriptions are untrusted and do not prove downstream privileges.

nine_questions.question: Can an agent retrieve something its human user cannot
nine_questions.unknown_before: Missing user identity, stale ACLs or unresolved conditions must not become allowed. Server-side service credentials must not silently replace the user's authorization.

nine_questions.question: Can the product redact, block or mask automatically
nine_questions.unknown_before: P1 is read-only posture. Automatic blocking is not a P1 claim. Detection confidence, formats, policies and path control limit protection.
